body.message:
We understand the inconvenience and sincerely apologize for any disappointment caused.

Please note that the apartment is offered at this rate considering the current condition and the interior. Given its location in Business Bay, the rate would generally be expected to be higher; however, we have priced it accordingly.

As the apartment is provided as listed, we are unfortunately unable to make changes to the existing interior or furnishings.

We truly appreciate your understanding and kind consideration.
